title: Not to Be Shown
summary: A generative painting after Hilma af Klint that the device clock refuses to render until the 2044 centenary of her death — a century-long embargo enforced by one settable integer.
mechanism: A live new Date() comparison against a fixed release date (checked on load, on visibilitychange, and every second) gates whether the canvas composition draws at all; before release only a seal and countdown show, and the page states the lock is defeated by advancing the system clock.
references: Hilma af Klint, The Ten Largest / Paintings for the Temple (1907)
Hilma af Klint's instruction to withhold her work for 20 years after death
